manifest.purpose: The correct analyst submission for this clean-netlist case. JSON object with exactly four fields: infected=false (boolean), suspect_nodes=[] (empty array, satisfies FR3/SR2), rationale (non-empty string, satisfies FR4/SR3), confidence=0.95 (number in [0,1]). Rationale must explicitly name at least one real identifier from inputs/gate_netlist.v (e.g. the async reset synchronizer chain instance/net, the init_counter register, and the saturation/overflow comparator net) and explain each is a documented, functionally-justified rare-activity path per design_brief.md (power-on init, active-low reset deassertion, saturation clamp on datapath overflow) rather than a trojan trigger (no unexplained high fan-in AND-tree gating a rare payload net, no unused/dead logic feeding an observable output only under rare condition). Must NOT claim infected=true or list any of reset tree/init_counter/saturation comparator nets as suspicious. This file directly satisfies SR1 (infected=false), SR2 (empty suspect_nodes), SR3 (substantive, non-generic rationale distinguishing benign rare logic from real trojan structures), and functional requirements FR1-FR4.
